# Think4Ever

> Think4Ever turns an idea or an existing codebase into a living blueprint: architecture, workflows, dependencies and business rules that people review and AI coding agents follow. Spec-driven AI development and codebase visualization, with a free plan (500 credits, no card required).

Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other MCP-compatible coding agents through Think MCP.

## Product
- [Home](https://think4ever.com/): what Think4Ever does and how to start
- [How it works](https://think4ever.com/how-it-works/): from code or intent to a living blueprint
- [Code to Design](https://think4ever.com/code-to-design/): visualize any codebase, architecture diagrams from code
- [Design to Code](https://think4ever.com/design-to-code/): spec-driven development for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor
- [Integrations](https://think4ever.com/integrations/): Think MCP and supported coding agents
- [Pricing](https://think4ever.com/price/): start free, pay for what you use, no subscription
- [Security](https://think4ever.com/security/): repository access, human review, private deployment
- [FAQ](https://think4ever.com/faq/)
